d: At Qatar Airways Group Medical Services, we are committed to supporting the health, wellbeing and performance of our employees through a range of healthcare and mental health services. The Mental Health Team works collaboratively to promote psychological wellbeing, deliver preventative initiatives and provide professional support services across the Qatar Airways Group.
r: We are looking for a Clinical Psychologist Assistant to support the Mental Health Team in coordinating psychological services and wellbeing initiatives across the Qatar Airways Group. Working under professional supervision, you will contribute to service delivery through data analysis, reporting, research support, educational resource development and administrative coordination while maintaining the highest standards of confidentiality and professionalism.
Support Clinical Psychologists, Psychological Counsellors and the wider Mental Health Team in the coordination of psychological services.
Assist in preparing psychological assessment materials, psychometric resources and related documentation under professional supervision.
Support the delivery of mental health awareness programmes, psychoeducation workshops and employee wellbeing initiatives.
Develop high-quality presentations, educational resources, reports and training materials.
Extract, analyse and report data to support service monitoring, evaluation and evidence-based decision making.
Support research activities, literature reviews, programme evaluation and service development projects.
Maintain service records and documentation in accordance with confidentiality, ethical and professional standards.
Coordinate departmental activities, meetings and related administrative requirements.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to support psychological services and employee wellbeing initiatives.

To be successful in this role, you should have
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Psychology or a related discipline.
Minimum 3 years of experience in psychology, mental health support, psychological services, research or a related healthcare environment.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, reporting and data visualization.
Strong Microsoft PowerPoint skills with the ability to create professional presentations and learning materials.
Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.
Strong analytical, organizational and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary healthcare environment.
Experience with psychometric assessments, clinical documentation and reporting is preferred.
Knowledge of psychological assessment principles and evidence-based mental health practices is advantageous.
Arabic language skills and eligibility for DHP registration/licensing would be an advantage.
